rules.codeLicense: MIT only (SPDX: MIT) for components and boilerplates. Registries that mix 'free + pro' are allowed ONLY for their free/MIT items; verify per item.
rules.fonts: OFL/SIL or system stacks only for webfonts (Google Fonts OK). Record license per font.
rules.evidence: Every entry: repo + how MIT was verified (GitHub API spdx_id or LICENSE) + date.
rules.endpoints: Every entry must have a served, keyless install path. Order: edit entry -> `sync` -> `onboard <@ns>` -> `verify` (verify reads the snapshot - sync first or it silently checks the old set). After ANY url / allowlist change: `sync`, then `verify`. After a `--style` change: re-run `onboard <@ns>` (the style is baked into the catalog at onboard time), then verify. Check one item before install: `verify --item @ns/<name>` (401/403 = gated). Notes are written from live statuses (index + sampled item, dated), never from directory metadata; record the working URL shape and any gated subset.
rules.fields: Required: name, homepage, license, licenseEvidence, verifiedAt, tags, notes, url (null ONLY for the CLI's own default registry - bare-name installs are correct there and nowhere else). Optional: catalogUrl (index override when homepage + /r/registry.json is wrong or throttled), integration (non-shadcn integrations are skipped by verify). Only MIT-allowlisted namespaces can be onboarded or verified.

registries.name: @shadcn
registries.notes: Core registry. url is null on purpose → onboard renders bare-name installs (button, card, …). /r/{name}.json 404s; item index is /r/index.json, item files live at /r/styles/<style>/<name>.json (verified 2026-09-21).

registries.name: @reui
registries.notes: 1773 catalog items, but 543 blocks are Pro (license key required; HTTP 401 without) — free set = primitives + c-* examples; kanban-board-*, dashboard-*, event-calendar-3/4, solution-bookings-* are all Pro, so verify an item is free before use. Style segment is <base>-<variant> and not free-form (base|radix × vega|nova|…); default 'base-nova' — onboard bakes it in unless --style is passed; the old /r/radix/<name>.json shape now 404s. Re-verified 2026-09-21.

registries.name: @velora
registries.notes: 64 items, token-aware (items carry cssVars). Left the live ui.shadcn directory (382 entries listed) as of 2026-09-21 — kept here as an allowlist-synthesized entry so the existing catalog stays valid; re-check availability before new installs.

registries.name: @cult-ui
registries.notes: 157 items. Directory health status 'observing' — re-check at use. If cult-ui.com rate-limits (429/Vercel checkpoint), onboard from the repo mirror: apps/www/public/r/registry.json (raw.githubusercontent.com/nolly-studio/cult-ui/main/apps/www/public/r/registry.json) saved to a file + --catalog-file. Mirror verified live 2026-09-21.

registries.name: @kibo-ui
registries.notes: 41 items (calendar, kanban, gantt, table, combobox, dropzone, status, ticker, tree, …). Verify per-item licensing at use; no pro tier found on the site (unverified).

registries.name: @diceui
registries.notes: 204 items; drag primitives: kanban, sortable, editable (dnd-kit + base-ui). Use the apex host — www.diceui.com serves HTTP 526 (dead TLS) on root and all paths; the /r/{name}.json shape works, /r/default/<name>.json 404s (verified 2026-09-21); the directory's {style} template is not served.
